editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding yourself trapped in the mind of a total psychopath. That is exactly where you go in this flick. You get a front-row seat as a nameless killer talks you through his life, explaining the exact moment he decided to leave being a normal person behind and start killing. The vibe is gritty and dark, making you feel like you are stuck in a room with someone who has completely lost his grip on reality. It is a wild ride that focuses more on the killer's head than big jump scares, which makes the whole thing feel much more personal and creepy.

The acting is surprisingly strong, as the main guy really sells the idea of a man who is both calm and dangerous. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the twists at the end make it worth the wait. If you love stories about how a villain is made, you will enjoy this.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the killer reveals that his stories were not just memories, but a way to lure you into his current trap. You realize you are actually his next victim. The movie wraps up with a dark twist showing that his cycle of violence never truly ends. He wins in the end, leaving you with the scary thought that there are people like him in the real world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves deep dives into the minds of serial killers.
